experiments.title: Controlled RZ(theta) Rotation Angle Sweep against Sign-Flipped & Random Controls
experiments.hypothesis: H1: Applying RZ(51.843 deg) provides a statistically significant enhancement in GHZ fidelity relative to random and sign-flipped controls.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Applying RZ(51.843 deg) produces a fidelity change indistinguishable from random controls (delta_F = 0).
experiments.baseline: Uncorrected GHZ state fidelity on ibm_fez (12 trials).
experiments.falsification_criterion: If |delta_F(51.843) - delta_F(random)| <= 3.0 * sigma (p > 0.05), H1 is formally REFUTED.

experiments.title: K8 Idle Delay Decay Curve Fitting (Exponential vs Oscillatory)
experiments.hypothesis: H1: Bell state fidelity exhibits a secondary revival peak at delay tau ~ 47 us.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Bell state fidelity follows pure monotonic T1/T2 exponential amplitude and phase damping.
experiments.baseline: Standard Lindblad master equation exponential relaxation.
experiments.expected_observable: Coefficient of determination R^2 of pure exponential fit vs sinusoidal revival fit.
experiments.falsification_criterion: If pure exponential fit yields R^2 >= 0.95 with no statistically significant Fourier peak at 47 us, H1 is formally REFUTED.
